title: Reading named token groups
description: You can follow a master pattern from token names to located output tuples.

steps.description: TOKEN_SPEC pairs each token name with a pattern. You combine them into named groups in MASTER.
lex reads each match's group name, text and column. Whitespace updates position tracking, and comments pass through without yielding a token.

steps.question: What information does a successful token yield contain?
steps.answer: It contains kind, lexeme, line and col. The error branch instead raises SyntaxError with the unexpected text and its location.

steps.description: You supply source text containing a declaration, a while loop and a print. The lexer scans that text rather than executing the loop.
You see ('KEYWORD', 'let', 1, 1) first and the final semicolon at line 5, column 12. Each printed tuple identifies one token and its source position.
